main_text.p: & cogitabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָשַׁב.
נַחְשְׁבִּי reputamur, נַחְשַׁבְתִּי reputor, præt. Niph. 1. pl. & 1. s. Rad. חָשַׁב.
כְּנְחָשָׁה quasi chalybea, sing. fæm. præf. No. f. m. נָחוּשׁ, Rad. נָחַשׁ.
נְחָשִׁים serpentes, auguria, pl. m. No. f. m. נָחָשׁ serpens, vel נָחַשׁ augurium, Rad. נָחַשׁ.
נְחָשָׁלִים debilitate affecti, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. חָשַׁל.
נְחַשְׁתִּי experimento didici, præt. Piel, 1. s. f. R. נָחַשׁ.
נְחַשְׁתִּי numella ærea mea, נְחַשְׁתָּה ærugo ejus, נְחַשְׁתְּךָ tua, נְחַשְׁתָּם æs eorum, נְחַשְׁתַּיִם numellæ chalybeæ, s. f. aff. & dual. No. נְחֹשֶׁת; R. נָחַשׁ.
נְחַשְׁתָּן nechuschtan, nomen serpentis, No. f. m. Rad. נָחַשׁ.
נַחַת descensus, quies, depositio, No. f. m. R. נָחַת descendit, vel No. f. f. R. נָחָה quievit, vel נָחַת statuit.
הַנְחֵת descendere fac, Imper. Piel, f. m. vel Infin. Piel, Rad. נָחַת.
נָחַת demissus est, נָחֲתוּ demissi sunt, (pro נְחַתּוּ) præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. נָחַת.
נְחַתָּה contritus est, נְחַתָּה contrita est, נְחַתּוּ contriti sunt, pro נָחַת, נְחַתָּה, & נְחַתּוּ; præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. R. חָתַת.
וַנְּחְתּוּם & obsignata fuerat, Esth. 8. 8. præt. Niph. 3. f. m. (pro נֶחְתָּם,) Rad. חָתַם.
וְנָחָתִּי & quievi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. נוּחַ.

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from the scan with low confidence in the pointing and some letters; the reading of several vowel points is uncertain and may contain errors. The running heads are Hebrew letters and are copied as printed. The last line "Niph." is treated as the continuation of the last entry, not as a catchword. The signature "Pp" at the foot of the left column is not transcribed as page furniture, since it is not clearly a gathering mark.
